source: Pfam/InterPro domain definitions; family labels follow the plant-jaspar-2024-rbh rule pack
notes: Only families with a single, well-established DNA-binding domain architecture are marked supported. Families with variable arrays, composite DNA-binding complexes or ambiguous domain roles are marked abstain so the extractor does not invent a DBD boundary.

AP2.source: Pfam PF00847 AP2 domain; AP2 subfamily carries two AP2 repeats

ARF.source: Pfam PF02362 B3 DNA-binding domain; PF06507 is an Aux/IAA interaction domain and is excluded

BES1.source: Pfam PF05687 BES1 N-terminal DNA-binding domain

C2H2.notes: zinc-finger copy number varies; array-boundary extraction is not implemented in v1

C3H.notes: zinc-finger copy number varies; array-boundary extraction is not implemented in v1

CO-like.source: Pfam PF00643 B-box and PF06203 CCT
CO-like.notes: the DNA-binding contribution of the B-box versus CCT region is not resolved for this pack

CPP.notes: DNA-binding role of the CXC region is not sufficiently established for transfer

DBB.source: Pfam PF00643 B-box zinc finger; double-B-box family

ERF.source: Pfam PF00847 AP2 domain; ERF subfamily carries one AP2 repeat

G2-like.source: G2-like (GARP) DNA-binding domain model in the pack

GRAS.notes: GRAS is not a canonical sequence-specific DNA-binding domain

GRF.source: Pfam PF08880 WRC DNA-binding domain; PF08879 QLQ is excluded

HB-PHD.source: Pfam PF00046 Homeodomain; PF00628 PHD is excluded

HRT-like.source: HRT-like DNA-binding domain model in the pack

LSD.notes: sequence-specific DNA-binding role is not sufficiently established for transfer

MYB.source: Pfam PF00249 Myb DNA-binding domain; two repeats

MYB-related.source: Pfam PF00249 Myb DNA-binding domain; one repeat

NF-YA.notes: NF-Y binds DNA as a heterotrimer; a single subunit DBD is not a valid transfer unit

NF-YB.notes: NF-Y binds DNA as a heterotrimer; a single subunit DBD is not a valid transfer unit

NF-YC.notes: NF-Y binds DNA as a heterotrimer; a single subunit DBD is not a valid transfer unit

RAV.source: Pfam PF00847 AP2 and PF02362 B3 DNA-binding domains

SAP.source: SAP DNA-binding domain model in the pack

STAT.source: STAT DNA-binding domain model in the pack

Trihelix.source: trihelix DNA-binding domain model in the pack

VOZ.source: VOZ DNA-binding domain model in the pack

WOX.source: Pfam PF00046 Homeodomain; Wus_type_Homeobox is overlapping and excluded

ZF-HD.notes: PF04770 is not the sequence-specific DNA-binding domain; the homeodomain architecture is not encoded by the pack rule
